_about: Data for ND Character Builder: parts, parameters, options and the words they turn into. Read by nd_nodes/character_builder.py (text) and js/character_builder.js (UI). Option fields: label (UI), tag (tags format: Danbooru tags; {n} and {m} are replaced by the parameter's n and m, {female:...|male:...} picks by sex; an empty tag falls back to a plain tag: ptag if given, else built from the natural-language words), adj (adjective used in a natural-language group), text (a whole phrase, used when the group has one parameter), post (a phrase placed after the noun), swatch (color), only (sexes the option suits; random skips it for others), weight (how often random picks the option, 1 by default), needs (random picks the option only when another parameter has one of these values, e.g. green skin only for orcs and goblins), word / noun / trait (race: a word before the noun, a noun that replaces it, features added after it), hint (tooltip text), shape (figure only: how the option changes the silhouette), solo (this option replaces the whole group phrase, e.g. 'a flat chest'), mutes (parameters of the same part this option switches off). Parameter fields: multi (up to this many options can be picked at once, e.g. mixed races), only (the parameter is used only for these sexes; it is hidden and left out of the text for the others), hint, set (use a shared option set), n (noun for {n}). Zone fields: copy (a button that copies values between parameters), presets (quick buttons that set several values). More parameter fields: requires (the parameter is used only when another one has one of these values, e.g. penis size only with a penis), random_sets (what random picks for a multi parameter, with only/weight), combos (extra tags and a lead phrase for a combination, e.g. futanari). Option fields: exclusive (in a multi parameter it excludes the others), neg (tag for the Negative output when the option is not chosen). Output field negative: the Negative text.
